alt.ru: Картина: светлая комната, в дверях худой мужчина в тёмном пальто, женщина в кресле привстаёт ему навстречу, за столом у окна сидят дети.
alt.en: Painting: a bright room, a thin man in a dark coat in the doorway, a woman in an armchair half rising towards him, children at a table by the window.
alt.pt: Pintura: uma sala clara, um homem magro de casaco escuro à porta, uma mulher na poltrona a meio de se levantar, crianças à mesa junto à janela.
alt.es: Cuadro: una sala luminosa, un hombre delgado con abrigo oscuro en la puerta, una mujer que empieza a levantarse del sillón, niños a la mesa junto a la ventana.

items.prompt: A Soviet physiology laboratory in the 1960s. A volunteer sits in profile at a heavy wooden table, head held still, biting a small wooden bar fixed to a stand. A tiny mirror on a suction cup sits on the eye; a thin pencil beam of light from a lamp reflects off it onto a slowly turning drum of photographic film. A framed reproduction of a painting stands on an easel in front of the volunteer. The light beam is the brightest thing in the room.

alt.ru: Лаборатория 1960-х: испытуемый в профиль зажал в зубах планку, тонкий луч отражается от зеркальца на глазу на барабан с фотоплёнкой, перед ним на мольберте картина.
alt.en: A 1960s laboratory: a volunteer in profile bites a wooden bar, a thin beam reflects off a mirror on the eye onto a drum of film, a painting on an easel in front.
alt.pt: Laboratório dos anos 1960: um voluntário de perfil morde uma barra de madeira, um feixe fino reflete de um espelho no olho para um tambor de filme, diante dele um quadro num cavalete.
alt.es: Laboratorio de los años sesenta: un voluntario de perfil muerde una barra de madera, un haz fino se refleja en un espejo sobre el ojo hacia un tambor de película, delante un cuadro en un caballete.

items.prompt: A long strip of developed photographic film lies on an archive light table. On it, thousands of hair-thin white lines form a dense tangled scribble, like a hand-drawn constellation: knots and clusters where the eye stopped, long straight jumps between them. Most of the film is dark and empty. A magnifying loupe rests at the edge.

alt.ru: Плёнка на световом столе: тысячи тонких белых линий движения глаза сплетаются в узлы и скачки, вокруг почти всё пусто, у края лежит лупа.
alt.en: Film on a light table: thousands of fine white eye-movement lines knot into clusters and jumps, almost everything else empty, a loupe at the edge.
alt.pt: Filme numa mesa de luz: milhares de linhas brancas finas do movimento do olho formam nós e saltos, quase todo o resto vazio, uma lupa na borda.
alt.es: Película sobre una mesa de luz: miles de finas líneas blancas del movimiento del ojo forman nudos y saltos, casi todo lo demás vacío, una lupa en el borde.
